item.title: The Most Expensive Part of AI Is Not the Model: Hidden Bills and TOKEN Syndrome
item.description: Short version The AI wave is no longer just about smarter models. It is becoming a hidden bill made of hardware, subscriptions, devices, attention, and anxiety. AI can make an individual step faster while making the complete workflow harder to manage. A new everyday symptom is emerging: TOKEN Syndrome—the constant fear of wasting tokens, running out of quota, or choosing the wrong model. Figure 1: AI is not a free desk.
